mapper.select: SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, user_id AS userId, total_amount AS totalAmount, original_amount AS originalAmount, status, address_id AS addressId, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, province, city, detail_address AS detailAddress, note, pay_method AS payMethod, pay_time AS payTime, ship_time AS shipTime, confirm_time AS confirmTime, ship_method AS shipMethod, tracking_no AS trackingNo, create_time AS createTime FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT id, order_no AS orderNo, user_id AS userId, total_amount AS totalAmount, original_amount AS originalAmount, status, address_id AS addressId, receiver_name AS receiverName, receiver_phone AS receiverPhone, province, city, detail_address AS detailAddress, note, pay_method AS payMethod, pay_time AS payTime, ship_time AS shipTime, confirm_time AS confirmTime, ship_method AS shipMethod, tracking_no AS trackingNo, create_time AS createTime FROM orders WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders( id, order_no, user_id, total_amount, original_amount, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, province, city, detail_address, note, pay_method, create_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{originalAmount}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{province}, #{city}, #{detailAddress}, #{note}, #{payMethod}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
